## h13.

**impl — construction — holders**

**The interface:** `markdown.Service` — defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55` (methods `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`).

**impl — the concrete implementation that runs at runtime**
- The unexported `service` struct — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`. It wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` and does all real work (parse → walk goldmark AST for tags/properties/snippets, `RenderHTML` via goldmark, `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag` via the `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` in `internal/markdown/renderer`). It is the only production implementation; `service` is returned as a `Service` by `NewService` (`markdown.go:85-113`, `return &service{md: md}`).
- (Second layer, worth noting: `service.md` is itself the third-party `goldmark.Markdown` interface, whose concrete value is built by `goldmark.New(...)` at `markdown.go:103`.)

**construction — who constructs it**
- `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` is called once in production, inside `NewAPIV1Service` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`. This is the single runtime instance, stored as `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`v1.go:56`).
- Also constructed in the test harness: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` (not runtime).

**holders — components that hold the `markdown.Service` interface as a field**
1. `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the owner/creator; used e.g. at `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`).
2. `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, built by `NewRSSService(...)` (`rss.go:58`). It receives the **same shared instance** — `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService`. Used for `RenderHTML` at `rss.go:339`.
3. `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, set by `NewRunner(store, markdownService)` (`runner.go:19`). The same interface is also threaded as a parameter to `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)` (`runner.go:74`), which `APIV1Service` invokes with `s.MarkdownService` (`memo_service.go:108` and `:447`).

So: one concrete `*service` value, created in `NewAPIV1Service`, is shared across the API service, the RSS service, and the memopayload rebuild path — all of which hold it via the `markdown.Service` interface.

## Markdown Processing Interface — Findings

### 1. The Interface
**`markdown.Service`** — defined at `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`

An 8-method interface for markdown metadata extraction and rendering:
- `ExtractAll` (line 33), `ExtractTags` (36), `ExtractProperties` (39), `RenderMarkdown` (42), `RenderHTML` (45), `GenerateSnippet` (48), `ValidateContent` (51), `RenameTag` (54)

It is backed by the `goldmark` library. The doc comment notes HTML rendering is primarily frontend (markdown-it); backend `RenderHTML` exists for RSS/server-side needs.

### 2. Concrete Implementation
**`service`** (unexported struct) — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`, wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown`. All 8 methods are implemented on `*service` (lines 143, 193, 244, 255, 264, 349, 356, 425). This is the only runtime implementation of `markdown.Service`.

Note: there is a *secondary, separate* helper type `MarkdownRenderer` at `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15` (constructor `NewMarkdownRenderer` at line 20). It is a plain struct, NOT an implementation of `markdown.Service` — it renders a goldmark AST back to markdown text and is used internally by `service.RenderMarkdown` (markdown.go:250) and `service.RenameTag` (markdown.go:451).

### 3. Construction Sites (`markdown.NewService`)
The factory is `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` at `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`. Called at:
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` — production construction inside `NewAPIV1Service`, with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44-47` — test construction (same options).

There is no other production `NewService` call; the single instance created in `NewAPIV1Service` is the one that propagates through the app.

### 4. Holders (structs with a `markdown.Service` field)
- **`APIV1Service.MarkdownService`** — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (assigned at v1.go:56). This is the origin/owner of the instance.
- **`RSSService.MarkdownService`** — `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`; constructed via `NewRSSService(profile, store, markdownService)` at rss.go:58 (field set at rss.go:62). Wired in `/bench/home/work/server/server.go:85`, which passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` — i.e., the same instance is shared. Used at rss.go:339 (`RenderHTML`).
- **`Runner.MarkdownService`** (memopayload) — `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`; constructor `NewRunner(store, markdownService)` at runner.go:19 (field set line 22). 

Additional consumers that take `markdown.Service` as a parameter (not struct-field holders):
- `RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` — `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` (calls `ExtractAll` at line 80). Invoked from `memo_service.go:108` and `memo_service.go:447`, each passing `s.MarkdownService` (the `APIV1Service` instance).

### Propagation summary
`markdown.NewService(...)` is called once in `NewAPIV1Service` (`v1.go:48`) → stored in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` → the same instance is handed to `RSSService` (via `server.go:85` → `NewRSSService`) and to `RebuildMemoPayload` calls in `memo_service.go`. The `memopayload.Runner` struct also declares the field, though in the server it is the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function that is actually invoked (I found no `memopayload.NewRunner` call site in `server/`).</result>
